summary: Track-steward initialization: optionally logs entry, locates light/glow scene nodes, queries the ground height at the track reference position, builds the steering waypoint arrays (count, positions and per-waypoint state) from the track reference speed, resolves pit-in/pit-out/finish/sector polygon scene nodes (setting render flags and logging when missing), places multiplayer starting vehicles according to the mode switch, and finally constructs a helicopter object when the helicopter scene node exists.
